verdict.rationale: Muse lets users link specific services (email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health/finance data) and can auto-generate custom connectors when APIs exist, but there's no evidence of a browsable 'directory' or marketplace of third-party apps/connectors to choose from — the emphasis is on ad-hoc linking and self-built tools rather than curated discovery. Missing for 10: an actual app/connector directory or marketplace UI, curated third-party integration listings, and any hands-on account of browsing such a catalog.
